policy: BE-SILC microdata is licence-restricted (Statbel/Eurostat scientific-use terms, the UK FRS posture): microdata and per-record outputs live only in the private artifact repo, public artifacts are aggregates only, and releases are identified by data_build_id plus HF revision — never ordinals.

licence.name: BE-SILC (Statbel/Eurostat scientific use)
licence.notes: Destination guards (an hf_destinations allowlist module + AST-scan test, the pattern proven on the UK licensed-data repo) land before any upload code exists — populace#262's first PR. No individual-level records in logs or CI output.

notes: source_coverage.json uses the country-neutral name (generalizing us_source_coverage.json per populace#265). reform_validation.json carries the EUROMOD-BE / Federal Planning Bureau comparators with in/out-of-sample labeling (populace#264). latest.json uploads last as the atomic pointer; the staging repo feeds the dashboard monitor ahead of release.
